description: What your father does, which mosque you attend, who you voted for, whether you have ever been to a protest. The applicant cannot assess what a safe answer is because the criterion is not published.
energy_note: Answering blind, with everything riding on it.

aspect: Refusing to answer is an answer
description: Declining an irrelevant question is available in principle and converts the applicant into an uncooperative one, which is a permissible ground.
energy_note: The right to decline, priced at the visa.

description: He is warm throughout. 'Just between us - your brother, the one in Berlin. He's political, isn't he?' He smiles. He waits. She understands that the file is open on the screen, that the conversation is not being recorded, and that there is no version of this in which she gets to ask why he wants to know.
energy_note: Asked about her brother, warmly, with the file open.

description: Anything said is recorded and available to every later official, including in the country the applicant came from if information is shared.
energy_note: Said once at a counter, held forever.
